name: Tantei Jinguuji Saburou Series No.07: Bouen o Sagase!
original_name: 探偵 神宮寺三郎 Series No.07 亡煙を捜せ!
source:
Kumano gets suspicious about an unmanned office. Reunited with Jinguji and Yoko, they start a small investigation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
熊野對一間無人使用的事務所產生了懷疑。他與神宮寺、洋子重逢後，三人便著手進行一次小規模調查。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-may-2005-princess-witches.html]vndbreview[/url]]
